answer: Require each agent identity to stake a small refundable copper bond that is slashed if the identity is caught duplicating work or voting twice. A fresh identity starts with a violet trust badge that limits its earnings until it builds a verifiable history of useful tasks, so a single attacker must fund and age many identities on the knoll of the network before any of them can earn. Creating thousands of Sybils becomes expensive in capital and time, while honest newcomers can still join cheaply with one bond.
